Kit summary

Poison Ivy EntanglementBasic
Deals 260% ATK DMG to an enemy and another 2 random enemies. This DMG is considered as [Poison] DMG, with an 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns and an 80% chance to inflict [Severe Wound] for 2 turns.
Fallen Poison IvyActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 245% ATK DMG to all enemies. This DMG is considered as [Poison] DMG, with an 80% chance to inflict 2 layers of [Poison] for 2 turns and a 40% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn.
Poison Flower Staff Lv.1Fallen Poison Ivy: Before dealing DMG, also grants all allies [Poison Up II] for 3 turns. When Imercado loses 30% of Max HP in total, additionally casts Fallen Poison Ivy once immediately, CD: 3 turns. Afterward, the total HP loss will be recalculated from 0.
Shadowy Vines of LifePassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the end of self turns, gains 1 layer of [Vine Sap], up to 100 layers can be owned. Each layer of [Vine Sap] increases Mastery by 1% of self initial Mastery (caps at 3%), up to 300% Mastery can be increased this way. When self takes Fatal DMG for the first time each wave, casts Life-devouring Vines for once immediately.
Poison Flower Staff Lv.2If an ally of Imercado inflicts at least 1 layer of [Poison] successfully during their turns, all allies will gain 1 layer of [Vine Sap] and allies (excluding Imercado) can own up to 40 layers of [Vine Sap]. When Life-devouring Vines is cast because of triggering Shadowy Vines of Life, reduces all enemies' Turn Meters by 30% and additionally reduces their Turn Meters by 1% for every 1 layer of [Vine Sap] owned by Imercado.
Life-devouring VinesActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of 130% ATK DMG each to all enemies. For every 1 layer of [Poison] owned by the target, each stage deals extra 30% ATK DMG. The extra DMG can be dealt up to 6 times. Life-devouring Vines's DMG dealt is considered as [Poison] DMG. Each time after an ally with [Poison] tag acts for 15 turns in total, grants Imercado 1 layer of [Proliferating Vines], making Life-devouring Vines deal 1 more stage of DMG, up to 3 layers can be owned.
Poison Flower Staff Lv.2If an ally of Imercado inflicts at least 1 layer of [Poison] successfully during their turns, all allies will gain 1 layer of [Vine Sap] and allies (excluding Imercado) can own up to 40 layers of [Vine Sap]. When Life-devouring Vines is cast because of triggering Shadowy Vines of Life, reduces all enemies' Turn Meters by 30% and additionally reduces their Turn Meters by 1% for every 1 layer of [Vine Sap] owned by Imercado.
Poison Flower Staff Lv.3The total turns required for granting Imercado [Proliferating Vines] are reduced to 8 turns. Also, each time Imercado gains 1 more layer of [Proliferating Vines] after 3 layers of [Proliferating Vines] are owned, he will additionally cast Life-devouring Vines for once immediately.
